items.title: File Einspruch against the Grundsteuerwert assessment
items.quote: Gegen diesen Bescheid kann binnen eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe Einspruch beim Finanzamt Musterweilburg eingelegt werden, schriftlich, elektronisch oder zur Niederschrift.
items.computation: Aufgabe zur Post (handover to the postal service) is stated as Samstag, 21.11.2026. The letter states the notice is deemed delivered (bekanntgegeben) on the fourth day after that posting (per the current wording of §122 Abs.2 AO): 21.11. + 4 days = 25.11.2026 (a Wednesday, not a weekend/holiday, so no shift needed for the delivery-fiction date). The one-month objection period then runs under §108 Abs.1 AO i.V.m. §§187 Abs.1, 188 Abs.2 BGB: the day of the triggering event (25.11.2026) is excluded, the period starts 26.11.2026, and ends on the day of the following month bearing the same number as the triggering date, i.e. 25.12.2026. 25.12.2026 (1. Weihnachtstag, Friday) is a statutory holiday in NW, 26.12.2026 (2. Weihnachtstag) is also a holiday and falls on a Saturday, and 27.12.2026 is a Sunday. Under §108 Abs.3 AO (in line with §193 BGB) the deadline moves to the next business day, which is Monday 28.12.2026.
